regime_context: Canada's Big Banks theme holds a dominant lead in momentum rank with strong durability and broad participation, but it is crowded. The absolute-trend gate remains validated for risk control on this market, supporting eligibility for trend-following. No single narrative is absorbing the majority of flow; rotation is non-directional.
emerging_watch: Pipelines & Midstream: the closest challenger with strong trend and high breadth, but unscorable. Watch for a confirmed handoff if the rotation margin closes to <0.1 and the theme becomes the new leader; remove watch if Big Banks maintain a margin >0.3 for 10 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Dominant trend-eligible theme with high durability and full breadth; the validated absolute-trend gate on this market supports a trend-following lean. Crowding flags a sizing caution, not a fade, given the reflexivity risk of fading the leader.
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.37) signals stretched positioning, and the momentum rank itself has no predictive return power; a sudden macro shock (e.g. credit event) could reverse leadership sharply.

falsifier.text: Big Banks theme loses eligibility (absolute-trend gate flips to false) AND its score drops below that of the #2 theme (Pipelines) by a margin greater than 0.3.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Mixed trend health and narrow breadth indicate an unconvincing momentum regime, making it likely to underperform the broader trend-following basket. The absolute-trend gate historically favours themes with stronger, coherent trends.
theses.dissent: A supply disruption or infrastructure stimulus could rapidly improve breadth and durability, causing a sharp relative rally in copper miners.

falsifier.text: Base Metals & Copper durability rises above 0.75 and breadth expands to >0.8, or it overtakes Oil & Gas Producers in rank.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
